summary: Infant son of the Munzingen carpenter Servaz Birkenmaier, who died in 1853 only weeks after his father; John's 4th great-uncle.
bio: Heinrich Birkenmaier was born in 1852 at Munzingen in Baden, the legitimate son of the carpenter Servaz Birkenmaier and his wife Agatha Heizler, and a younger brother of Maria Anna. He died at Munzingen in May 1853, still a small child, about three weeks after his father, who had died on 19 April. He was John's 4th great-uncle.
sources: Landesarchiv Baden-Württemberg, Staatsarchiv Freiburg, L 10 Nr. 1591 (Munzingen, Catholic parish, Standesbücher 1840–1870; 631 images; record id 5-480947), deaths 1853 No. 9 http://www.landesarchiv-bw.de/plink/?f=5-480947-286
